Press release of 4 Oct 2023 (PDF, 1 page, read in full): five dynamic signs under the new concession, including Bassens (avenue Raoul Bourdieu); concession with Keolis 'officialisée en juillet 2022'; the short-stay (2-5 days) tariff offer was 'votée lors du conseil de métropole du 29 septembre 2023' and covers La Gardette Nord & Sud among 11 car parks. The night parking for residents is only said to be offered by 'l'opérateur et Bordeaux Métropole' at some sites; the release does not say the council voted it, but the draft wording ('voted a short-stay offer ... and a night-parking offer') reads as if both were voted. The signs are described as already installed ('ont été implantés').
items.corrected_text: Under the Keolis concession officialised in July 2022, five dynamic signs showing free park-and-ride spaces were installed, one of them on Avenue Raoul Bourdieu in Bassens, according to a Bordeaux Métropole press release of 4 October 2023. It says the metropole council voted a new tariff offer on 29 September 2023 allowing short stays (2 to 5 days) at some park-and-rides, including La Gardette Nord and Sud. The operator and the metropole also offer night parking at some of them for nearby residents without private or on-street parking.

items.corrected_text: According to a Bordeaux Métropole page last updated on 28 May 2025, public on-street charging posts have charged, since 6 January 2025, 0.38 EUR per kWh including tax, plus 4.00 EUR per hour of occupation once a session on a slow socket passes 4 hours (waived from 11pm to 8am on alternating-current sockets), with a maximum of 48 EUR including tax after 14 hours of session. Whether these rates still apply in October 2026 was not confirmed.

corrected_summary: Bassens is a commune of the Gironde department on the right bank of the Garonne in Bordeaux Métropole, with a port and industrial zone covering 60% of its territory. Car parking policy is set mostly at metropole level. The TBM network lists two park-and-ride car parks at La Gardette, which the municipal page names as the terminus of tram line A, with 242 spaces open to all and 151 for season-ticket holders only. Non-subscribers pay 4.50 EUR a day (3.50 EUR reduced rate at La Gardette), and 2-to-5-day stays cost 12 to 25 EUR; a local news report of 29 September 2026 says the day ticket is planned to rise to 5 EUR in 2027, which is not yet confirmed by an official text. The two TBM pages disagree on closing hours and the out-of-hours fine (15 vs 25 EUR). A station interchange with 68 car spaces was inaugurated on 24 June 2025. Bordeaux Métropole's low-emission zone has applied inside the ring road since January 2025, but the metropole's page does not say whether Bassens lies inside it. No municipal on-street paid-zone or resident-parking rules for Bassens were found, so this briefing is thin on the town's own regulation.
